description: index-service.md links to a page whose filename in the Markdown snapshot is `7%5Fusing%5Findex.md` - percent-encoded underscores (%5F) in a filesystem path. This is a snapshot-conversion artifact rather than an authoring error, but the link does not resolve as written and the same bug will affect any other converted link containing an underscore. Worth a sweep of the whole snapshot for %5F rather than a one-page fix.
